name: Korean peninsula
value: Last launch 4 Nov; envoy to Moscow 14 Nov
summary: North Korea fired missiles on 4 Nov; a senior party delegation flew to Moscow on 14 Nov; no launch found since
state: South Korea's military detected multiple missiles fired towards the East Sea from the Sondok area on 4 Nov; Pyongyang said it had tested a new air defence missile system and held a long-range cruise missile drill (Korea Herald, citing Yonhap). A delegation led by party secretary Jo Yong-won flew to Moscow on 14 Nov at the invitation of Dmitry Medvedev, and North Korean troops remain deployed in Russia's war (SBS). No new launch, nuclear test or clash was found as of 15 Nov; the 4 Nov launch and troop deployment keep Watch.
for_you: Residents of South Korea and Japan may see missile alerts; follow national emergency guidance. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for South Korea and Japan.
